  PROBLEM: The hardcoded `phase_labels` list is a maintenance hazard and can leave stale phase labels on issues when new labels are added elsewhere.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2333-2402 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:177-180 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `jq` command substitution at line 177 is not guarded against failure.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, a jq failure exits the shell before the fallback POST add path can run.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151-152 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded `phase_labels` array is missing several phase labels defined in the color/description maps.
  WHY: Missing phase labels prevent the atomic swap from removing them, leaving conflicting phase labels on the issue.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:197-200 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `PR_DATA` emptiness check uses `tr -d '[:space:]'`, which can miss partially truncated payloads.
  WHY: A truncated payload can still look non-empty and bypass the API refetch fallback, leading to incorrect issue extraction.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2333-2402 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` function has inconsistent warning messages and brittle sourcing logic.
  WHY: The warning text differs from the main implementation and the sourcing logic can fail if paths or permissions change.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:182-183 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `new_labels` command substitution is vulnerable to shell termination under `set -euo pipefail`.
  WHY: If `jq` fails, the non-zero status will exit the workflow step before the fallback logic can run.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Hardcoded phase labels create a maintenance synchronization hazard and potential atomic swap failure.
  WHY: If a new phase label is added elsewhere but not to this list, old labels will not be removed and conflicts will remain.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2333-2402 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` definition contains inconsistent error handling and brittle sourcing.
  WHY: An empty `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` can lead to bad `source` paths, and the inline fallback behavior differs from the script version.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:197 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The PR metadata completeness check is brittle.
  WHY: A non-empty but truncated payload can skip refetching and fail to recover the full issue-reference text.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, jq failure exits the function before the fail-open POST fallback runs.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:145 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded `phase_labels` JSON array is a maintenance burden.
  WHY: If a new phase label is introduced but not added here, old phase labels will persist alongside the new one.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2482 vs lines 2382 and 3085 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The POST fallback warning messages are inconsistent across the inline fallback implementations.
  WHY: The differing warning text does not change behavior but makes debugging and log parsing inconsistent.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:197 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The PR_DATA fallback check may miss incomplete payloads.
  WHY: A truncated body can skip API refetch and cause linked issues to be missed.
